sentiment.rationale: The document reports a strong Q3 with revenue at the high end of guidance and adjusted EBITDA at an all-time high. Forward guidance for Q4 revenue (7-10% YoY) and GBV (low-double-digits) is positive, and full-year adjusted EBITDA margin guidance was raised from a 34.5% floor to approximately 35%. However, the Q4 nights and seats booked growth is guided to mid-single digits, which is a deceleration from Q3's 9% and reflects a tough comp, tempering the bullishness. The overall tone is confident but not exuberant, with management emphasizing continued investment in growth initiatives.

summary.revenue: $4.1 billion, up 10% year-over-year, landing at the high end of guidance.
summary.guidance: Q4 2025 revenue expected $2.66B-$2.72B (7-10% YoY growth). Q4 GBV expected to grow low-double-digits YoY. Q4 nights and seats booked expected mid-single-digit YoY growth. Full-year 2025 adjusted EBITDA margin now expected ~35%, up from the 34.5% floor previously shared.
summary.margin: Q3 2025 adjusted EBITDA margin of 50% (vs 52% in Q3 2024). Full-year 2025 adjusted EBITDA margin expected ~35%.
key_risks: Tough year-over-year comps in Q4 2025 for nights and seats booked.
Q4 2025 adjusted EBITDA expected flat-to-down slightly YoY, margin declining, primarily due to investments in new growth and policy initiatives (~$200M into services/experiences in 2025).
Net income impacted by a one-time $213 million valuation allowance related to Corporate Alternative Minimum Tax credits.
key_opportunities: Reserve Now, Pay Later payment offering driving acceleration in the US, to be rolled out more broadly next year.
International expansion: average nights booked in expansion markets growing at double the rate of core markets.
New businesses: Services, Experiences, and Hotels each expected to be multi-billion dollar opportunities over time.
AI integration: AI customer support already reduced need to contact a human agent by 15%; AI-powered conversational search rolling out next year.
Share repurchase program: $6.6 billion remaining on authorization; fully diluted share count reduced by 8% since 2022.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Management uses phrases like 'another strong quarter,' 'exceeded our expectations,' and 'we're encouraged by the continued momentum,' reflecting a confident outlook.
